messages:
Priya: Noticed a spike in SCIM 401s for acme-inc org after last night's RBAC rollout. IdP logs show SAML NameID mismatch and OIDC 'aud' validation failures for client `acme-client-legacy`. Anyone touching client rotation?
Tom: We rotated the client_id and secret during the maintenance window to retire long-lived creds. I did not update the SCIM connector for that tenant (oversight).
Luca: KMS team here. Around 02:45 UTC there were ~7 InvalidCiphertextException errors on alias/infra/idp-key+v3 while a rekey propagated. Could be why some tokens failed to decrypt.
Priya: SCIM shows retries creating users, and some users now have two service accounts (extId collision). Probe log: `2026-04-02T02:47:01Z scim: 401 Unauthorized - aud mismatch for client=acme-client-legacy`.
Tom: Quick mitigation: add legacy client to gateway audience whitelist and schedule coordinated config rollout. @infra-bot can you apply temporary allowlist?
infra-bot: gateway update applied by infra-bot: `gateway.aud.allowed += acme-client-legacy`
Luca: KMS errors coincided with a key promotion job that had partial propagation to eu-staging. I'm requeueing a re-encrypt sweep for objects with decryption failures.
Priya: We also found a debug dump in s3://dev-dumps/acme/debug-2026-04-02.log that contains `oauth_client_secret` in plaintext. That file was created by a one-off debug job with wide bucket perms.
Tom: Ugh. Immediate steps: 1) rotate client secret, 2) purge S3 object + run s3:DeleteObject marker, 3) revoke client refresh tokens, 4) tighten IAM for debug jobs. I'm rotating now.
Luca: KMS re-encrypt sweep started. Alert rule proposal: fire when InvalidCiphertextException >= 5 in 5m for any alias. Filing INF-999.
Priya: Fix for SCIM idempotency incoming: check extId before create and PATCH existing user instead of fallthrough create. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/scim/compare/patch-idempotency
Tom: After rotate + re-encrypt + SCIM patch, probe run shows no new duplicates in last 45m. Exported reconciliation set: s3://redwood-incident-exports/scim-recon-1790001111.csv
SRE Oncall: Postmortem actions: 1) require a coordination checklist for client_id/secret rotations (SCIM, gateway, IdP), 2) prevent debug uploads with secrets via CI scan, 3) add KMS invalid-cipher alert (INF-999), 4) add a reconcile job to merge duplicate service accounts by extId and last_active.
Priya: I'll own the reconcile job and open a follow-up RFC for rotation playbooks. Leave the gateway whitelist for 24h and I'll confirm with affected tenants before removal.
Tom: :thumbsup: Will follow up with a short incident note for customers and include mitigation steps.
Luca: KMS team will run a full propagation check and post status. If anything else pops up ping me in this thread.
